items.content_text:
### APIs Covered Under APILayer Suite!

- Name: [Refnusa](https://refnusa.dev/)

  Description: Indonesian holidays, wages, regions, postal codes, tax, food prices and NIK/plate checks (31 tools)

  Auth: No

  Transport: `HTTP`

  Install: [Glama](https://glama.ai/mcp/connectors/dev.refnusa/refnusa)



### Calendar

- API: [Africa Compliance Data](https://africacompliancedata.com/docs)

  Description: Public holidays and business days for all 54 African countries, from official sources

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes


- API: [CountdownsHQ](https://countdownshq.com/developers)

  Description: Dates and timezone-correct countdowns for 150+ holidays and observances in 18 countries

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Email

- API: [Nitrosend](https://docs.nitrosend.com/api)

  Description: Send marketing and transactional email; manage contacts, segments and flows

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: No



### Food & Drink

- API: [FiberUp Fiber Database](https://fiberup.app/data/)

  Description: Dietary fiber per serving and per 100 g, split into soluble and insoluble, for \~200 common foods

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Government

- API: [UK Public Tenders by Trade](https://tools.gptshopltd.com/api/uk-tenders/)

  Description: Live open UK public sector tenders by trade from Find a Tender and Contracts Finder (OGL v3.0)

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Jobs

- API: [Present of AI](https://presentofai.com/developers)

  Description: AI company profiles, open AI jobs and dated AI news, REST and MCP

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Open Data

- API: [StackRates](https://stackrates.ai/ask/)

  Description: VPS and cloud server prices from 46 providers, read daily from their own pricing pages and APIs

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Social

- API: [InsightSocial](https://www.insightsocial.app/docs)

  Description: Public profiles, posts, comments and followers from 25 social platforms, free tier

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes


- API: [Revolt](https://developers.revolt.chat/)

  Description: Revolt open source Discord alternative

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Unknown


- API: [TwittrAPI](https://www.twittrapi.com/docs)

  Description: Public Twitter/X data: profiles, tweets, replies, search, followers, lists, communities, trends

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Weather

- API: [Pirate Weather](https://pirateweather.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)

  Description: Free weather API with forecast data similar to Dark Sky

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes

items.title: Awesome Roadmaps
items.content_text: ### Infrastructure / Operations * [Cloud Engineer Roadmap](https://ciphemicacademia.in/roadmaps/cloud-engineer/) - Project-based AWS cloud engineering roadmap covering identity, networking, storage, deployment, infrastructure as code, and disaster recovery. * [Wyrcan Engineering Roadmap (⭐17)](https://github.com/Wyrcan-io/roadmap) - Text-first 12-stage engineering curriculum covering systems, DevOps, cloud architecture, and MLOps with interactive checkpoints. ### AI / Machine Learning / Data Science * [Machine Learning Roadmap](https://quiddityml.com/blog/how-to-learn-machine-learning-roadmap/) - Self-study machine learning roadmap covering Python, mathematics, PyTorch, and ML foundations, with staged concept lists and study-time estimates. ### Miscellaneous * [Knowledge Navigator (⭐5)](https://github.com/MohamedMuneerM/knowledge-navigator) - Interactive learning map with goal-based roadmaps and chapter prerequisites across STEM and other disciplines. ### Articles & Books * [Frontend Framework Interview Preparation Roadmap](https://frontendatlas.com/guides/framework-prep) - Guide mapping frontend interview preparation across JavaScript, React, Angular, and Vue, with 7, 14, and 30-day study plans.

items.title: Awesome Mac
items.content_text:
### Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

*   [Eleven (⭐776)](https://github.com/Zfinix/eleven) - Open-source reverse-engineering app where coding agents read, rename and patch binaries, Android apps and GPU kernels alongside you. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Zfinix/eleven) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Developer Tools / Virtualization

*   [Mac Android Subsystem](https://harkhowalia-1.github.io/MacSubsystemForAndroid/) - Run Android apps on Apple Silicon, each in its own Mac window with its own Dock icon. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/harkhowalia-1/MacSubsystemForAndroid) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Terminal Apps / Databases

*   [SSHFire (⭐7)](https://github.com/aralozaltin/sshfire) - Cross-platform SSH client with a terminal, a session manager and an SFTP browser that follows the current directory. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/aralozaltin/sshfire) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

*   [TetherCam](https://tethercam.app/) - Use an iPhone as a USB camera on a Mac for video only, or use the OBS plugin for video and the phone's microphone audio. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Kanevry/tethercam) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

*   [Peel](https://peel.tuguidragos.com/) - Free, open source uninstaller and cleaner that removes apps with every file they leave behind, shows you why each file belongs, and moves everything to the Trash, so you can put it back. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/TuguiDragos/Peel) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

items.title: Open Source Flutter Apps
items.content_text:
### Productivity

*   [akou](https://openappscout.com/apps/akou/) - akou is a GPL-3.0 call recorder for Apple silicon Macs that transcribes on the device, with no bot in the meeting and no account, and saves the notes to files you own. ([Source (⭐14)](https://github.com/GeiserX/akou))

### Tools

*   [VPN Bypass](https://openappscout.com/apps/vpn-bypass/) - A macOS menu bar app that sends chosen services and domains around a corporate VPN, or only those through it, and puts the routes back when the VPN reconnects. ([Source (⭐127)](https://github.com/GeiserX/VPN-Bypass))

### Developer Tools

*   [Device Hub Pro](https://openappscout.com/apps/device-hub-pro/) - Native macOS app to manage and mirror Android emulators, Android phones, iOS simulators and iPhones side by side. ([Source (⭐1)](https://github.com/gitemre/device-hub-pro))
*   [Orbi](https://openappscout.com/apps/orbi/) - Orbi is an AGPL-3.0 system that turns labelled GitHub issues into reviewed, merged pull requests and tagged releases, using GitHub issues as its only state store; Orbi Cloud is the hosted offering. ([Source (⭐220)](https://github.com/orbi-build/orbi))
*   [SolidPing](https://openappscout.com/apps/solidping/) - SolidPing is an AGPL-3.0 uptime monitor that runs as a single Go binary or Docker image, on SQLite by default, with a hosted free plan. ([Source (⭐17)](https://github.com/fclairamb/solidping))

### Games

*   [Patzer](https://openappscout.com/apps/patzer/) - Self-hosted Chess.com alternative: game review for your Chess.com and Lichess games, play vs Stockfish or a friend, AI coach on your own Ollama or vLLM, in one Docker container. ([Source (⭐42)](https://github.com/SikamikanikoBG/patzer))

### Travel

*   [Pumperly](https://openappscout.com/apps/pumperly/) - Pumperly is an AGPL-3.0 map of fuel prices and EV chargers with a route planner, free to use at pumperly.com with no account or to run yourself with Docker Compose. ([Source (⭐44)](https://github.com/GeiserX/Pumperly))

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Commands & Extensions

*   [US Watchlist Alerts (⭐2)](https://github.com/eli-alvarado/us-watchlist-alerts) - Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for a US stock watchlist: NYSE-aware, de-duplicated price alerts (levels, % moves, gaps, 52-week highs/lows, MA crosses, RSI, earnings) and morning/close briefs. Stdlib Python, no API key, never places trades. MIT. Install with `npx skills add eli-alvarado/us-watchlist-alerts -y -a gemini-cli`.

### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [ChatVault (⭐24)](https://github.com/ssanaullahrais/Chat-Vault) - Windows app that reads, searches and backs up your Gemini CLI chats across accounts, and continues any chat in Gemini CLI through a handoff file that carries the whole conversation.
*   [laya-guard (⭐30)](https://github.com/scs0209/laya-guard) - Local guardrail with a `BeforeTool` hook for Gemini CLI (`laya-guard install gemini-cli`) that judges each shell command before it runs, using regex rules, protected paths, and a small on-device model. Blocked commands are denied; ones marked for review pass with a note. Also hooks into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agents. MIT.
